title: Pregnancy Food Safety Analysis: Sushi, Salads, BBQ, and Cheese Boards
excerpt: A pregnancy food safety analysis of international favorites like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards
content:
## Introduction
When it comes to pregnancy, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. However, with the variety of international dishes, many pregnant women often wonder what to eat and what to avoid. In this article, we will analyze the safety of international dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards for pregnant women.

## Food Safety Analysis
According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html) and [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/keeping-well/foods-to-avoid/), pregnant women should avoid eating the following foods:
* Uncooked sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed salads
* Undercooked meat and eggs
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

However, not all international dishes are unsafe. For example, cooked sushi and sashimi or pasteurized cheese can be eaten. Salads that have been washed and combined with nutritious foods like fruits, vegetables, and nuts can also be a good option.

## Nutrient Combination
To ensure adequate nutrition, pregnant women should combine the following foods:
* Fruits and vegetables: rich in vitamins and minerals
* Nuts and legumes: rich in protein and fiber
* Meat and fish: rich in protein and iron
* Dairy and cheese: rich in calcium and vitamin D

For example, a salad combined with fruits, vegetables, nuts, and legumes can provide adequate nutrition for pregnant women. A BBQ with cooked meat and fish can also be a good option.

## What to Avoid
Pregnant women should avoid eating the following foods:
* Uncooked sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed salads
* Undercooked meat and eggs
* Unpasteurized soft cheese
* Expired or spoiled food

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, pregnant women should:
* Always check the expiration date and condition of food
* Wash hands and utensils before preparing food
* Cook food to a safe temperature
* Avoid eating expired or spoiled food

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women have any questions or concerns about food safety, they should seek help from their doctor or a registered dietitian. Additionally, they can consult reputable sources like [Pregnancy Meal Planner](https://pregnancymeal.tips/blog) for accurate and helpful information.
